fusions.name: Coffle Rivet
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 13 damage, leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Portcullis Drop
fusions.desc: Strikes the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Driven Palings
fusions.desc: Hammers a row of bars 5 tiles long into the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Held for the Blow
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
